daysSinceDelivery.title: Days Since Delivery
daysSinceDelivery.description: Whole days between the delivered date and today. Blank if not delivered or not found.

found.title: Found
found.description: True if a matching order was found, false otherwise.

insideWindow.title: Inside Window
insideWindow.description: True if the order was delivered within the policy return window. Blank if not found, not yet delivered, or the policy record is missing.

isDelivered.title: Is Delivered
isDelivered.description: True if the order has a delivered date recorded.

windowDays.title: Window Days
windowDays.description: The return window length, in days, used for this check.
